summary: Update linked local submittals for an External Submittal.
description: Adds or removes local submittals linked to an External Submittal. At least one of linked_local_submittals_added_ids or linked_local_submittals_removed_ids must be provided.

id.description: Unique identifier of the linked local submittal.

revision.description: Revision label of the linked local submittal. Null when the submittal has no revision.

title.description: Title of the linked local submittal. Null when the submittal has no title.

status.description: Current status of the linked local submittal. Null when the submittal has no assigned status.

linked_local_submittals_added_ids.description: IDs of local submittals to link to the External Submittal.

linked_local_submittals_removed_ids.description: IDs of local submittals to unlink from the External Submittal.
